gamefaqs.section: Action Replay Max DS (.duc) Game Save (Europe)

format: Action Replay DS save: the 500-byte 'ARDS000000000001' header (game 'Mario Kart: DS', name 'mkds'), then 100240 bytes raw for the 256 KiB flash (padded 100240 -> 262144 with 0xFF)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/nds-ards.py IN step0.bin, then tools/gamefaqs/nds-cores.py step0.bin --chip 262144 --stem 'Mario Kart DS (Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It)' --out DIR: drops the Action Replay header; fits it to the 262144-byte chip (padded 100240 -> 262144 with 0xFF) and writes each core's file
